about_the_game:
The Monster Con is back in town! Put on your favorite cosplay and grab your autograph book, because you’re going back to the craziest convention ever… with 2 brand new playable characters to choose from!

  • Warm Walter is a sleep expert whose favorite activity is catching some Zs. This big, marshmallow-faced fella loves finding the perfect spot for a quick nap, and cuddling is his love language. After his brief appearance in "Monster Roadtrip", you can now become Walter as he looks for someone who could become his little spoon.

  • But Walter's not the only "Monster Roadtrip" breakout NPC: Bradphomet is a yoga instructor with supernatural deep-breathing skills, and they're both physically and morally flexible. Become Bradphomet as they look for love, even if that means damning a few people to the eternal torment of Hell. If you like stretching your body and don’t mind selling your soul to the devil, Bradphomet is literally the GOAT for you.

Get ready to nerd out with hot monsters... and be a hot, nerdy monster yourself!

content_descriptors.notes: Use of mature language in a humorous way.
